create_gateway_stream_consumer: create a GatewayStreamConsumer instance to bridge sync agent callbacks to async platform message delivery
run_stream_consumer: run the async GatewayStreamConsumer task that drains deltas and progressively edits platform messages
filter_think_blocks: filter and accumulate streamed text deltas while suppressing reasoning/thinking blocks
send_fallback_final: send the final continuation text after progressive streaming edits stop working
clean_for_display: clean streamed text by stripping MEDIA directives and audio markers before display
